newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong dollar soft, currency forwards widen.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong dollar soft, currency forwards widen.

text.p: * Hong Kong dollar soft, U.S. bank reported to have taken large position -- several hundred million U.S. dollars -- in Hong Kong dollar forwards, which at record levels

* Traders initially assumed buy program -- which started late Friday -- indicated speculative activity against Hong Kong dollar but dealers now say the unidentified bank was unwinding long HK dollar position taken in anticipation of bumper initial public offering, Beijing Enterprises
* Money market liquidity still tight, defying expert prediction of loose liquidity when HK$230 billion in Beijing Enterprise cash returned to system
* Tight liquidity and weakness in Hong Kong dollar turned spreads in two-year positive for first time in months
* Dealers said all the Beijing Enterprise cash has not yet worked its way through the system
* Unless liquidity eases by Tuesday, dealers expecting intervention by Hong Kong Monetary Authority
* Hong Kong stock market expected to dictate direction, with capital inflows to a strong market countering weak trend in the Hong Kong dollar
* EFN yields: 3yr 6.45 pct, 5yr 6.84 pct, 7yr 7.11 pct, one week 5.62 pct
